title: Delay and Missed Connection Benefits of the Travel Protection Plans
content:
Where a traveller insured under the Travel Protection Plans is held up in transit, two benefits answer:
travel delay, which carries both an overall limit for each insured traveller and a daily ceiling within it, and
missed connection, which carries an overall limit alone. Each is payable from its own trigger onward.

| Plan | Travel delay | Travel delay trigger (hours) | Daily ceiling within travel delay | Missed connection | Missed connection trigger (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 300 | 12 | 150 | 0 | 0 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 500 | 8 | 200 | 500 | 6 |
| TripGuard Plus | 1000 | 6 | 250 | 1000 | 3 |
| TripGuard Premier | 1500 | 5 | 300 | 1500 | 3 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 1500 | 5 | 300 | 1500 | 3 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 1000 | 6 | 250 | 1000 | 3 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 2000 | 3 | 400 | 2500 | 3 |

Amounts are in USD. Trip Basics Essential carries no missed connection benefit, and its 0 limit and 0 trigger
record that absence rather than a benefit payable from the first hour.

## The triggers put as conditions

A delay of 4 hours reaches the travel delay trigger of Annual Multi-Trip Executive, which stands at 3 hours, and
reaches no other plan's: TripGuard Premier and Cancel For Any Reason Elite trigger at 5 hours, TripGuard Plus
and Annual Multi-Trip Traveller at 6, Trip Basics Standard at 8 and Trip Basics Essential at 12. A missed
connection caused by an arrival 3 hours late reaches the trigger on every plan that carries the benefit except
Trip Basics Standard, whose trigger is 6 hours.

Within the travel delay benefit the daily ceiling runs 150, 200, 250, 300, 300, 250 and 400 across the seven
plans in the order of the table, against overall limits of 300, 500, 1000, 1500, 1500, 1000 and 2000; the
missed connection limits are 500 on Trip Basics Standard, 1000 on TripGuard Plus and Annual Multi-Trip
Traveller, 1500 on TripGuard Premier and Cancel For Any Reason Elite, and 2500 on Annual Multi-Trip Executive.
